name: tft-coach-desktop
description: TFT real-time coaching overlay with screen capture and computer vision

scripts.build:frontend: python backend/sync_frontend_icons.py && cd frontend && vite build
scripts.dev: cross-env TFT_COACH_BACKEND_MODE=demo concurrently "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run start:delayed"
scripts.dev:live: cross-env TFT_COACH_BACKEND_MODE=live concurrently "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run start:delayed"
scripts.dev:sim: cross-env TFT_COACH_BACKEND_MODE=sim concurrently "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run start:delayed"
scripts.verify: npm test && npm run check:model && npm run build:frontend && python backend/test_current_set_defaults.py && python backend/test_app_paths.py && python backend/test_unit_details.py && python backend/test_ocr_cache.py && python backend/test_detection_regressions.py && python backend/test_unit_detail_sorter.py && python backend/test_train_unit_details.py && python backend/test_system.py
scripts.package: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend && node scripts/releaseReadiness.js && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish never
